title: Mobility and periodic registration update not accepted by the network

entities.name: Mobility and periodic registration update procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE for mobility or periodic registration update, which can be rejected by the network with various 5GMM cause values.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REJECT message
entities.description: Message sent by AMF to reject a mobility and periodic registration update request, containing a 5GMM cause value and optional IEs.

entities.name: 5GMM cause value
entities.description: IE included in REGISTRATION REJECT message indicating the reason for rejection (e.g., #22 congestion, #62 no network slices available).

entities.name: T3346 value IE
entities.description: IE containing the value for back-off timer T3346, used in congestion control scenarios.

entities.name: Timer T3346
entities.description: Back-off timer started by UE when registration is rejected due to congestion, preventing further registration attempts until expiry.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state
entities.description: 5GMM state entered by UE after registration rejection, with substates like PLMN-SEARCH or LIMITED-SERVICE.

entities.name: Message integrity protected
entities.description: Condition indicating whether the REGISTRATION REJECT message was integrity protected, affecting UE behavior.

entities.name: UE stores forbidden TAI
entities.description: Behavior where UE stores TAI in forbidden lists (e.g., for roaming or regional service) after registration rejection.

relations.description: The mobility and periodic registration update procedure includes the network sending a REGISTRATION REJECT message when not accepted.
REGISTRATION REJECT message contains the 5GMM cause value IE indicating rejection reason.
REGISTRATION REJECT message may contain T3346 value IE for congestion control.
UE starts timer T3346 upon receiving REGISTRATION REJECT with T3346 value IE, if integrity protected.
Receipt of REGISTRATION REJECT causes UE to transition to 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.
UE behavior of storing forbidden TAI is guarded by whether the REGISTRATION REJECT message was integrity protected.
For certain 5GMM cause values (e.g., #76, #78), REGISTRATION REJECT requires integrity protection; if not, UE discards the message.
